days.title: Val Vobbia Rocks and Castles
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Rocche del Reopasso
stops.detail: The Rocche del Reopasso are included in the Reopasso oasis (1,221 ha) and are an important rock formation consisting of extensive outcrops of Savignone conglomerate dating back to the Oligocene epoch.

stops.name: monte Reale
stops.detail: These are: the area of the peak of Mount Reale, the Vobbia stream and the Stone Castle, the ecomuseum of the Brevenna valley, the area of the peak of Mount Antola and its connected refuge, the Brugneto lake and finally the Casa del Romano astronomical observatory;

days.title: Antola Peaks and Historic Villages
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Senarega
stops.detail: In Senarega, in the Brevenna valley, the thousand-year-old Fieschi castle has recently been restored by the Park.

stops.name: Pentema
stops.detail: The village of Pentema, a hamlet of Torriglia, is instead famous for the peasant nativity scene that takes place there every year and which represents a sort of ethnographic museum of the peasant civilization of past centuries in the Antola valleys.
